path.desc: 物理neck_skin的统一绘画范围，与原guide同形；防止多个色层的抗锯齿累积越过范围。不是独立投影receiver蒙版，raw投影保持不裁切。

g.desc: 颈部连续皮肤。可见双侧承接下颌与双肩；上圆端和下宽弧为已通过的隐藏连接范围；锁骨归 body。
单一哑光皮肤材质，参考无遮挡颈前基色约RGB253/236/233；不是临时轮廓色。上/下隐藏运动余量使用相同肤色连续铺满；不绘锁骨或衣料。

path.desc: 完整闭合皮肤基色；与guide neck/neck_skin同轮廓，保留所有运动余量。
所属 neck/neck_skin。完整填色闭合边界，上端 y274、下端 y406 为运动余量；颌缘两侧 y302–355 和肩根 y355–376 连续。最终只显双侧实体外缘，顶部及底部隐蔽闭合线留白；隐藏端也维持连续皮肤。
所属 neck/neck_skin。起于左颌后 (411,305)，沿左颈至左肩接界 (378,373)。最终细软描边，中段约0.7px，端部淡出；头发重叠区域留由后续遮挡。与闭合皮肤底形共边，硬外缘、柔和内侧。
所属 neck/neck_skin。右肩接界 (500,376) 至右颌后 (467,302)，参考原形不对称收束。最终约0.7px细软描边，两端淡出；与闭合皮肤底形共边，上端隐蔽余量不描线。
所属 neck/neck_skin。左颈肌由颌后阴影内 (414,336) 向胸骨上窝左缘 (431,386) 收束；只作极淡软转面/后续明暗导向，不作硬实线。中段约0.3px，头尾各6px完全淡出；不描锁骨；不作为独立物理分割。
所属 neck/neck_skin。右颈肌由 (463,336) 向胸骨上窝右缘 (446,387) 软收束，与左侧保留中央亮面；结构位置参考线稿。最终弱色阶转面，0.3px以下渐隐，不保留硬边或纹理线；下端接body凹陷但锁骨不在本part绘制。
所属 receiver neck/neck_skin。上界贴近 head下颌 (411,307)→(437,323)→(467,303)，下界渐弱收至(440,351)。外来投影来源head下颌，最终由独立cast_shadow色面接管，辅助线不显影；上边约1px清晰、下边2–4px柔软，封闭投影可见范围。head尚无具体part，因此关系后续follow=head。
所属neck/neck_skin，自身体积左转面。左颈侧向肩根的薄暖暗面与外缘闭合，过渡宽约5–9px，最终融入皮肤渐层不留描线；上端延续到隐藏颌后，不能替代head投影。
所属neck/neck_skin，自身体积右转面。右颈柱边缘与肩根闭合，软过渡约6–10px；参考亮皮肤的极淡暖灰侧面，最终由色面接管不描线，上方隐藏区连续延长。
所属neck/neck_skin，颈前中央柔和亮面范围；沿两颈肌之间向胸骨上窝收束，宽约8–17px，没有硬高光；仅作色面辅助，3–6px渐隐边缘，不显描线，闭合至起点。
neck/neck_skin 自身圆柱体积：颈前保持亮肤色，双侧沿颈肌转面弱暖暗，肩根平缓展开；渐层无硬边并覆盖运动余量。head下颌投影不在本层绘制。 最终对照参考把自身暗面对比降至50%，避免把柔软颈柱绘成条带；外来投影仍独立。

ellipse.desc: neck/neck_skin 颈侧靠肩根的极淡暖粉过渡，按参考皮肤局部色；径向透明渐隐，位置固定于本part，不是外来投影。
neck/neck_skin 颈侧靠肩根的极淡暖粉过渡，按参考皮肤局部色；径向透明渐隐，位置固定于本part，不是外来投影。

path.desc: neck/neck_skin自身颈肌转面阴影，依据structure源曲线；细窄但模糊渐隐，非硬描线，头尾变窄，止于body锁骨上方；不叠加外来下颌投影。
neck/neck_skin自身颈肌转面阴影，依据structure源曲线；细窄但模糊渐隐，非硬描线，头尾变窄，止于body锁骨上方；不叠加外来下颌投影。

ellipse.desc: 参考颈前的宽柔漫反射亮部，弱暖白径向渐隐，附着在neck_skin表面。皮肤没有硬镜面高光、金属边光或独立发光；不在外来下颌投影上叠亮。

path.desc: 来源 neck_neck_skin_side_left；真实 perfect_freehand 1.2.0 显式压力密采样，size1.45、simulate_pressure=False、streamline=0；4px起笔与6px收笔，垂直渐隐，原guide轮廓裁切；保留隐藏源曲线。 最终线色由颌后暖灰紫向肩根浅暖棕渐变，压低暗线对比，保留原压力轮廓。
来源 neck_neck_skin_side_right；真实 perfect_freehand 1.2.0 显式压力密采样，size1.45、simulate_pressure=False、streamline=0；4px起笔与6px收笔，垂直渐隐，原guide轮廓裁切；保留隐藏源曲线。 最终线色由颌后暖灰紫向肩根浅暖棕渐变，压低暗线对比，保留原压力轮廓。

g.desc: 独立完整下颌投影raw层。owner=neck/neck_skin; follow=head; clip_to=neck/neck_skin。色面上延至y281、横向至x398..480，为移动和receiver裁切留余量；本层不附receiver clip或物理树路径，后置总控步骤5统一裁切。

path.desc: head下颌投在neck_skin的较浅外层投影，中心尖端y352，柔软下沿；保留超出receiver的完整几何，以参考现姿明暗为准。
head下颌投在neck_skin的近下颌较深内影，渐隐至y341；保留超出receiver的完整几何，以参考现姿明暗为准。

g.desc: Continuous torso skin: shoulders, clavicles, ribcage and abdomen. No temporary leotard boundaries. Hidden neck-root, shoulder joints and pelvic overlap remain complete. Local anatomy and skin shading continue across areas exposed by normal motion.

Owner body/torso_skin. The complete parent-derived closed silhouette; top neck-root and bottom pelvic arcs are hidden fill closures and must have no final outline. Shoulder sockets retain their rounded hidden ends. Hard geometry edge, softly tapered final stroke; no separate fabric seam.

Owner body/torso_skin. Observed soft clavicle-underplane shadow, 3–9 px feather, follows visible collarbone; filled warm rose not drawn border. Continuous beneath front hair.
Owner body/torso_skin. Observed right clavicle-underplane shadow; low opacity warm tint, slightly clearer inner edge and broad soft falloff; no neckline.

Owner body/torso_skin. Central self-occlusion valley: near-vertical deepest narrow middle fades toward chest top, broad feather 3–7 px. Region closed between two chest front planes; no clothes boundary.
Owner body/torso_skin. Soft central upper-chest light wedge extending from neck front; feathered skin illumination, no line; primary light from frontal upper left.

Owner body/torso_skin. Caster head front hair left; receiver body/torso_skin. Narrow cool warm-grey contact shadow on skin immediately behind forelock from shoulder into lateral chest; source head group pending specific hair parts. Later independent shadow layer, not self-shading or physical part.

g.desc: Final material: exposed shoulder/chest reference is pale peach with diffuse frontal light, warm shallow clavicle shadows and narrow cool hair contact shadows. Covered chest/waist is inferred as continuous skin with restrained soft volume, not a garment. Neck, arm and pelvis interface fill remains complete; no dark seam at hidden root/bottom closures.

Independent shadow owned by body/torso_skin, follow=head, receiver=body/torso_skin. Full uncut hair-cast source includes upper and lateral motion reserve; receiver mask is intentionally deferred to final cross-group composition. Front hair is the caster, not a physical child of body.

path.desc: Full raw source of left front-hair shadow. Soft cool rose contact shade fades along strand and beyond torso; retained outside receiver for moving overlap. Source guide remains hidden in torso sources.

g.desc: Independent shadow owned by body/torso_skin, follow=head, receiver=body/torso_skin. Full uncut hair-cast source includes upper and lateral motion reserve; receiver mask is intentionally deferred to final cross-group composition. Front hair is the caster, not a physical child of body.

path.desc: Full raw source of right front-hair shadow. Soft cool rose contact shade fades along strand and beyond torso; retained outside receiver for moving overlap. Source guide remains hidden in torso sources.

g.desc: Continuous pelvic body with completed waist and hip-root overlap; temporary white suit is not a surface or boundary. Hidden closures are not visible seams.

path.desc: pelvis/pelvis_body. Closed physical fill from waist at (357,643) around both completed hip roots and central lower edge to upper overlap y=620. Body and legs cover closure arcs; retain all hidden surface for modest relative movement. Diagnostic 0.55 px curve only; final visible ink is limited to lateral hip edges. No holes; central leg gap remains outside this closed surface.

pelvis/pelvis_body visible left waist-to-hip edge. Connects body at upper endpoint and leg at lower endpoint. Soft 0.6–1.15 px pressure stroke with tapered endpoints; keep hidden continuation uninked. Skin fill closes independently through contour.
pelvis/pelvis_body visible right waist-to-hip edge. Body/leg endpoint overlap; fine soft edge, pressure 0.15 to 0.8 to 0.15, no line across the hidden lower bridge. Fill uses full closed contour.

pelvis/pelvis_body left lateral hip-to-upper-leg shallow turn, from (352,755) to (382,770). Supported by soft skin shading beside the temporary garment, not garment opening. Hidden under leg in assembly; retain gentle 0.35–0.8 px tapered warm line for small exposure. Both ends fade; no closed crease and no central anatomical mark.

pelvis/pelvis_body right lateral hip-to-upper-leg shallow turn, from (529,755) to (499,770). Mirror-related soft turn with matching pressure; mostly under right leg. Both endpoints disappear; narrow tonal hint, not the suit edge and not a closed line.

pelvis/pelvis_body left self-turn shade boundary. Darker on the outer-left side toward full contour, closes through contour at top/bottom. Soft transition 20–35 px; follows skin form and existing light from upper front. Hidden hip root continues same diffuse material. No final ink; transferred to color planes.

pelvis/pelvis_body right self-turn shade, darker toward right outer contour, closes via contour. Soft 20–35 px transition corresponding to left body volume; no external caster inferred. Auxiliary only; color planes replace this boundary.

pelvis/pelvis_body lower body-plane turn, beneath leg-root overlap. Very broad and low contrast, 12–20 px fade toward lower completed contour, no central anatomical line; no final ink. Corresponding fill area closed through bottom contour and fade to transparent above.

pelvis/pelvis_body broad upper-front lit core, no hard highlight or visible edge. Closed diagnostic zone, fully soft 30–50 px transition to surrounding skin, color/highlight stages take over; auxiliary only. No suit seam is represented.

Continuous matte skin base for pelvis/pelvis_body, including all motion overlap. Adjacent reference arm/upper-leg median RGB about (253,235,232); selected base (252,233,229) allows shallow form shade and diffuse light. Single material; temporary suit seams do not divide the skin.

g.desc: Self-form shading follows pelvis surface; broad upper-front light with subtle rose lateral turning planes. Skin is matte and translucent, not suit material. All edges soft; no caster relationship.

path.desc: Full-surface low-contrast volume fill; closed skin range retains movement overlap.
Broad lower-plane turn under leg-root overlap; diffuse shading, never a central anatomical stroke.

g.desc: Warm local skin undertone across lateral hip mass with very weak cool ambient edge; diffuse color modulation only, no garment division. Continuous with pale rose skin of adjacent reference thighs.
Very shallow self-fold tones beside lateral hip structure; warm soft fade, mostly under leg-root overlap. No central sexual detail or garment seam, no external cast shadow.

path.desc: Low contrast warm self-turn, softly blended at both ends; no hard edge. Follows corresponding hip_turn source curve.
Low contrast warm self-turn, softly blended at both ends; no hard edge. Follows corresponding hip_turn source curve.

g.desc: Wide diffuse upper-front light on matte skin; no hard specular patch. Surface-bound light continues onto hidden overlap. No independent reflection or glow layer needed.

Pressure-rendered closed brush from pelvis_pelvis_body_outer_right. Perfect-freehand 1.2.0; 257 explicit (x,y,pressure) samples, simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0. Tapered and opacity-faded endpoints. Original curve and full intent retained in source_curves.

Pressure-rendered closed brush from pelvis_pelvis_body_hip_turn_left. Perfect-freehand 1.2.0; 257 explicit (x,y,pressure) samples, simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0. Tapered and opacity-faded endpoints. Original curve and full intent retained in source_curves.

Pressure-rendered closed brush from pelvis_pelvis_body_hip_turn_right. Perfect-freehand 1.2.0; 257 explicit (x,y,pressure) samples, simulate_pressure=False, streamline=0. Tapered and opacity-faded endpoints. Original curve and full intent retained in source_curves.

desc.desc: Rendering stack checked against pale warm skin adjacent to the hips and upper legs. Neutral geometric ink recolored to muted rose-brown, preserving pressure shapes and end fades. Lateral and lower shade reduced to match the soft low-contrast skin reference. Central surface remains smooth without invented sexual detail. Body and legs formal art are outside this branch; cross-group seams are reserved for final composition.
